programme.title: Loud Louie
programme.desc: Doc finds her old toy cell phone, Louie, in the toy box, and discovers that his volume control is stuck in the 'loud' position, which makes games like 'Hide and Seek' and 'Telephone' a little tricky.

programme.title: Hauntley Girls
programme.desc: Vampirina and her mom start a book club. The first book is magical and spells the humans. They work hard to break the spell. Will they succeed?

programme.title: Shelliemay The Disney Bear Duffy's New Friend
programme.desc: ShellieMay the bear is a perfect best friend. This is the tale of how ShellieMay came to be, how Minnie made the stuffed bear and filled her with joy so that Duffy would have a best friend by his side.

programme.title: A Time for Courage
programme.desc: Follow Mulan's courageous journey as she disguises herself to take her father's place in the Imperial Army, defending China against the Huns in this inspiring story.

programme.title: Ducky And Bunny's Big Plan
programme.desc: A delightful Disney story featuring Ducky and Bunny, where friendship and humor drive a fun-filled plan that leads to adventure and laughter along the way.

programme.title: Vampirina In The Fall
programme.desc: Vampirina thinks Fall has this amazing chill in the air, the crunch of leaves, the scent of rotten apples. Follow along with word-for-word narration and join Vampirina and her favorite season of all.

programme.title: Undercover Princess
programme.desc: Enjoy Disney Junior stories with Bingo, Rolly, Mira, and Mickey! Each story is perfect for a quick read in about five minutes. Fun adventures await!

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Pooh's Secret Garden
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and Winnie the Pooh is planting a garden. Follow along with the word for word narration in this delightful tale to see what surprises are springing up in Pooh's secret garden!

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.title: Back On Track
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow along with word-for-word narration and meet Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and the rest of the crew from Cars 3!

programme.title: Duty
programme.desc: Different classes in society are intertwined, with each person's actions impacting others. When individuals from various classes fulfil their responsibilities, stability is achieved. This story explores fairness and the expression of duty among people from different social strata.

programme.title: Cycle Of Sorrows
programme.desc: Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father’s regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he’s caused?

programme.title: Electric Piya
programme.desc: A high school girl brings a new bulb for her study lamp. The bulb is anthropomorphic and he is exultant and joyful for having the luck of lighting for her. As he lights, he falls in love with the young girl.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Foul
programme.desc: Against the setting of a journey to Thailand, Ayush, a lustful businessman, possesses both the capability and cleverness to be unfaithful to his wife and shatter her aspirations of moving to Canada. Yet, the question remains: Can he thwart her pursuit of realizing her dreams?

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: Complaint
programme.desc: A journey of a 12-year-old girl who visits the police station to report the disappearance of her bicycle. At the station, a police officer undertakes a heartwarming action to restore the child's trust, earning the admiration and faith of all those present. This incident serves as a powerful testament to our inherent, albeit sometimes unquestioning, belief in the police force.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Gunjaaish
programme.desc: A heartfelt journey of a couple raising a child with autism, discovering the power of love, resilience, and community. Featuring autistic actors, this ground breaking film celebrates acceptance and the beauty of being different.

programme.title: Doughnut
programme.desc: Sameer, on his afternoon break from work, walks into a restaurant hoping for some quiet time. However, a doughnut with supposedly magical properties has him in for a shock. Fearing the unreal powers he suddenly acquires, he hurries out. How does a young woman who walks in right then change Sameer's attitude towards the magical doughnut?

programme.title: Faatima
programme.desc: Faatima is a story of two unknown individuals who meet each other for the first time at a cafe and share with each other some very interesting facts only to make us realize that good souls do exist.

programme.title: Firki
programme.desc: It's the way many father's typically behave when their children start driving. The idea of using the navigation tool to highlight the generation gap is also based on my own life experience. The title is Firki because the family is spinning around like a Firki without having reached their destination in the film. It's also depicts how they've been taken for a ride by the navigation app, or as we say in Hindi....Firki le li

programme.title: Faboo
programme.desc: Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves. Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.

programme.title: Dhoop Haskar Boli
programme.desc: A determined daughter walks into a matrimonial office with her quiet, circumspect mother. What follows next is an awkward conversation with a charming executive and an inward journey for all three.

programme.title: First Sin
programme.desc: What would you do if you unexpectedly obtain magical powers? Ashwath, a failed businessman is having a troubled relationship with his wife . One fine morning he gets a Sand-timer at his door steps. Life takes a turn when he discovers magical powers in it. Will the Sand-timer be a boon or curse ?

programme.title: Fear Of Wheels
programme.desc: This film beautifully captures the emotional interplay between the vibrant, ambitious youth and the helpless, world-weary elders, showcasing the poignant struggle between generations. As a person reaches a certain stage in life, they observe numerous things happening around them, yet feel incapable of taking action. Over time, they become reliant on others even for the most basic tasks. This narrative portrays those individuals who experience old age gradually tightening its grip around them.

programme.title: Double Blind
programme.desc: A Rendezvous of childhood friends takes place in a dark alley of Mumbai, among the chaos and hustle of the city that never sleeps.

programme.title: Damdi
programme.desc: Damdi, is a story of a young boy. Whose parents left him in childhood, was pampered by her grandmother by working as a babysitter. Damdi has grown up and works in a garage, also studying together. A dear friend Paltan keeps warning him against good and evil. A garage owner Lallan bhaiya acts as a guide. Damdi is in love with a girl Gunja. He has an addiction and attraction towards intoxication, becoming the heart's weakness. Heartbreaks and despairs but returns to a new direction in life again.

programme.title: Destiny's Two
programme.desc: Mohan and his dwarf wife have come to Mumbai from Gujarat for his work. They are a newly wed couple. Their marriage is a compromise, as they do not see the spouse of their imagination in each other. Mohan who gets fascinated seeing taller women realizes the same about his wife. He decides to go to a red light area to fulfill his desire. But does he do it?

programme.title: Chup Chap
programme.desc: Following a newlywed couple enjoying a robust and empathetic bond, their world takes a turn during a party with friends, sparking a profound shift in their perspectives. Despite their differing opinions, both stand firm in their convictions. When an issue deeply troubles the wife, she bravely advocates for justice. After a prolonged battle, legal verdict is achieved. Yet, uncertainties linger about the truth behind this justice, leaving the tale shrouded in ambiguity.

programme.title: Jai Mata Di
programme.desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

programme.title: Naamkaran
programme.desc: When it comes to new beginnings, families have a way of always being there. Sometimes it's as simple as a good- morning forward. But for Jay, it's something slightly more dramatic. Watch Naamkaran, as Jay and his (uninvited) family take on a new challenge.

programme.title: Deuce
programme.desc: A mother and a son argue about love, insecurities and acceptance around an intense match of table tennis. Who wins? Who loses? Watch Deuce.

programme.title: El'ayichi
programme.desc: What happens when you have a dead but clingy husband, an irritated wife, and a fossilized dodo in the same house? Experience love, way past its 'expiry' date.

programme.title: L
programme.desc: A mother's dream of riding a scooter is not as easy as it seems.

programme.title: Banana Bread
programme.desc: Shruti is home alone during the pandemic when the arrival of someone redefines what's acceptable in a time of Distancing. A sweet, tender little film which reveals different flavours as you savour it. (Take a bite!)

programme.title: Kashmir
programme.desc: A bereaved son grapples with his loss and in turn understands his relationship with himself. Kashmir is an introspective dialogue between a person and a distant place you call home.

programme.title: R.i.p
programme.desc: Two old men wake up to the same matrimonial ad in the morning paper. What follows is something totally unexpected. After all, it's never too late to find love!

programme.title: Long Drive
programme.desc: Vikram, Zain and Aman are on a long drive together. But when Vikram takes an unexpected turn, his friends aren’t sure what to expect. Will they make it back in time? And does Vikram have something on his mind? Watch Long Drive to find out.

programme.title: Aamad
programme.desc: "Aamad" in essence is the story of a father and son and their shared inheritance of loss. An inheritance that tears them apart and yet binds them together. Abhay returns home to find his father on his deathbed. Old painful memories resurface. Will he be able to make amends for the faults of his past? As his father passes on, will this be Abhay’s rites of passage? Will Abhay heed the call of the bloodline, despite the tinkering strains of the past?

programme.desc: An experimental night in bed ends up with a mark for the world to see. As the world looks at the mark left in bed, the couple is forced to look inside themselves and their relationship.

programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Panic
programme.desc: A riveting psychological thriller that propels an aspiring actor's life into chaos when a toothache triggers an unfounded belief in oral cancer, setting off a catastrophic chain of events.

programme.title: Alvida
programme.desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

programme.title: An Astrologer's Day
programme.desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

programme.title: Chhoti Si Baat
programme.desc: Plot. Chhoti Si Baat is a romantic comedy about a painfully shy young man Arun Pradeep (Amol Palekar), who lacks self-confidence and fails to stand up for his convictions, in the process letting all and sundry walk all over him.

programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

programme.title: Luv Kush
programme.desc: After Ram returns to Ayodhya, Sita is forced to go into exile. She gives birth to twins Lav and Kush, who later go to Ayodhya to attain blessings of Ram and recite the Ramayan.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Mumbai
programme.desc: After Assistant Commissioner Agnel Wilson (Randeep Hooda) unsuccessfully attempts suicide, he recounts his story of the Mumbai, India, underworld, which he'd been investigating for decades. It begins with the tale of Sultan Mirza (Ajay Devgan), a smuggler. Wilson attempts to take Sultan down through the gang leader's relationship with a Bollywood actress, but his attempt fails. Then a rising gangster, Shoaib Khan (Emraan Hashmi), overthrows Sultan -- but the power struggle is far from over.

programme.title: Sarkar
programme.desc: Sarkar, an influential man, is falsely charged with the murder of an upright politician. When he is imprisoned, his son Shankar steps into his shoes as a leader to protect his father and their legacy.

programme.title: Lajja
programme.desc: The Film follows four women from different backgrounds in India as they unite to fight against misogyny and violence in their society. Forced marriage, domestic abuse, and honor killings are just some of the struggles they face. Through their determination, they discover the strength of the human spirit, inspiring others to join their fight for justice. With a powerful cast and storyline, sheds light on important social issues and the fight for women's rights. Will these women succeed in creating a better future for themselves and future generations?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 01
programme.desc: What happens when a fearless Delhi boy meets a fiery Mumbai girl? Chaos, charm, and clashes ensue. Will opposites attract or collide? Watch Alright's new weekly web series - Delhi vs Mumbai's episode 1 - When Delhi guy meets Mumbai girl.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 02
programme.desc: In this hilarious episode 2 of Delhi vs Mumbai, our favorite duo is on an all-too-relatable mission: flat hunting! ?? From endless negotiations with brokers in Delhi ?? to squeezing into Mumbai’s tiny flats ???, the chaos is real. Will Chirag find his home in this city or not?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 03
programme.desc: Imagine living with your crush amidst the iconic Delhi vs Mumbai clash—where one city’s chaos meets the other’s charm, turning every day into a blend of cultures and a rom-com adventure. Sharing breakfasts, late-night talks, and unexpected quirks, is it a dream come true or a reality check? Living with your crush in such a whirlwind brings fantasy and reality head-to-head like never before!

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 04
programme.desc: What happens when opposites fall in love? Chaos, comedy, or the ultimate love story? Delhi vs Mumbai—where one orders butter chicken, the other swears by vada pav. One speeds through wide highways, the other navigates traffic like an art form. From “Bhai” to “Banta hai,” their worlds clash in a battle of slang, street food, and stubborn pride. But here’s the twist—somehow, between the endless debates and culture shocks, sparks fly. Is it war, or is it love? Maybe, just maybe, it’s both.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 05
programme.desc: Say no to Valentine’s Day when your boyfriend is too romantic, and you’re the complete opposite! One loves grand gestures, the other prefers chill vibes—can love survive this Delhi vs Mumbai clash?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 06
programme.desc: When your partner is a walking green flag, every day feels like a rom-com—thoughtful gestures, endless support, and no unnecessary drama. From remembering your coffee order to hyping you up like their full-time job, they seem too good to be true. But in a world full of red flags, is it possible to find someone this perfect, or is there a twist waiting to unfold?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 07
programme.desc: Who truly has your back—your boyfriend or your best friend? ?? In this episode of Delhi vs Mumbai, we put relationships to the ultimate test! From loyalty checks to emotional dilemmas, watch as Delhi and Mumbai episode 7 to prove whose squad reigns supreme.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 08
programme.desc: When your partner cheats on you, the signs can be subtle or right in your face—but are they real, or just overthinking? A sudden change in behaviour, secretive texts, and those mysterious "work calls" at odd hours—are you reading too much between the lines or just ignoring the signs?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 09
programme.desc: Ex ki waapsi is always when you’ve finally moved on. The memories resurface, the what-ifs linger… but will you turn the page or reopen the book? Is it fate giving you another chance, or just a test to see if you’ve really moved on?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 10
programme.desc: Holi with Girlfriend is nothing short of magical—colours in the air, laughter in every splash, and love in every stolen glance. As you chase each other with vibrant hues, the world fades, leaving just the two of you in a whirlwind of playful mischief and stolen kisses. Amidst the chaos of colours, one thing is certain—her smile is the brightest shade of happiness.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 11
programme.desc: When your girlfriend wants to pay, it’s a true test of modern love—are you chivalrous enough to insist, or progressive enough to accept? The debate begins: Is it about equality, or does footing the bill define a gentleman? The waiter awkwardly stands by as you both exchange glances, waiting to see who taps the card first. In the end, is love about splitting everything equally, or about knowing when to let the other person win?

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 12
programme.desc: Ruhaani from Mumbai travels to Delhi to meet Chirag’s family—who also happens to be her boyfriend. As she navigates the warmth and chaos of Delhi's culture, she uncovers surprising truths about his family, their expectations, and where she truly stands in his life.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 13
programme.desc: In Episode 13, Ruhani’s lavish surprise for Chirag collides with his secret plan to move back to Delhi for his mother and a major opportunity, leading to an emotional confrontation that tests their love and leaves both with a bittersweet, unsent goodbye.

programme.title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 14
programme.desc: In the gripping final episode of Delhi vs Mumbai, emotions run high as Chirag (Abhishek Kapoor) and Ruhani (Malhaar Rathod) face the ultimate test of love. With tough decisions about career, family, and their future together, will distance and city-based differences pull them apart — or will love triumph over all?
